item.title: 10 Reasons You Need an Independent, Offsite Backup in 2026
item.description: Cloud storage isn’t a backup strategy. 10 reasons you need an independent, offsite backup you control, from ransomware and rogue AI agents to climate, conflict, and storage cost.

item.title: Plakar Control Plane is now on AWS Marketplace: Resilience on your terms
item.description: Plakar Control Plane, the self-hosted backup management platform built on open-source Plakar, is now available on AWS Marketplace. Deploy it in your own AWS account in a few clicks; your backup data never leaves your environment.

item.title: Introducing the Plakar Control Plane free plan: Open Resilience for everyone, deployed on your terms
item.description: We’re launching a free plan for our first commercial product, Plakar Control Plane — a self-hosted backup management platform built on top of open-source Plakar. Fully functional, no time limit, deployed on infrastructure you own.
